data.title: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft for infringement

(Photo by Samuel Boivin/NurPhoto via Getty Images) | NurPhoto via Getty Images The Seattle Times and Newsday are just the latest plaintiffs to take OpenAI to court, alleging copyright infringement.
